_comment: Text + VLM sample: a small text model and a Qwen3-VL, both resident at once. A chat request carrying an image_url content part routes to the VLM slot automatically; everything else goes to the text slot. Copy next to genie-server.py as env_config.json and adjust paths.
_comment_coresidency: THIS COMBINATION IS FRAGILE AND HAS TO BE MEASURED. On the SA8255P we tested it loads only when BOTH of these hold: (1) the text bundle is exported at a SINGLE context length, and (2) the two slots are on DIFFERENT device_id. The identical setup with a multi-context-length text bundle fails with 'err 1002' even though that bundle allocates byte-for-byte the same amount - so on-disk size and 'Allocated total size' will not tell you in advance. SLOT_LOAD_ORDER did not matter here, but leaving it text-first costs nothing. See MANUAL.md, 'Loading two models at once'.
_comment_poll: POLL:false turns off the HTP backend's busy-wait (measured on SA8255P: ~260% CPU for no latency gain). Remove it to keep whatever each model bundle sets.

TEXT_SLOTS._comment: A SINGLE-context-length bundle. This is the part that decides whether the VLM fits next to it.
TEXT_SLOTS.name: chat

VLM_SLOTS._comment: Different device_id from the text slot - the same core does not work. max_tokens caps generation for the whole slot: the request's own max_tokens cannot reach the VLM path (GenieNode takes it once, at node creation). 0 = uncapped.
VLM_SLOTS.name: vision
